name: Motor-imagery BCI EEG and behavioural assessment in prolonged disorders of consciousness
access_route: https://doi.org/10.15125/BATH-01632 (University of Bath Research Data Archive)
license: Not stated on landing page; data-use conditions prohibit redistribution - REQUIRES VERIFICATION
n_participants: 42 patients + 2 able-bodied benchmark (UWS n=14; MCS n=17; LIS n=11)
n_recordings: Multiple sessions per participant - exact count REQUIRES VERIFICATION
recording_duration: Structured MI-BCI sessions; exact duration REQUIRES VERIFICATION
event_markers: YES - task cue onset/offset and rest periods; baseline -1000 to 0 ms re cue
behavioral_exams: YES - CRS-R and WHIM linked to EEG session
verification_method: Fetched and parsed the DOI landing page
known_limitations: ACCESS IS RESTRICTED - not a download. Small n for training. Repeated sessions create dependence. A negative motor-imagery result does not establish absence of consciousness.
leakage_risks: Repeated sessions per participant - MUST split at participant level not session level
role_in_project: PRIMARY command-following dataset (Layer E). The only public-facing source of the strongest evidence tier.

name: The raw data of resting EEG of patients with prolonged disorders of consciousness
n_participants: 59 patients + 32 controls (per investigator brief - subject count REQUIRES VERIFICATION against files)
recording_duration: Sixty 2-s epochs per subject (per brief - REQUIRES VERIFICATION)
labels_available: NO subject-level labels of ANY kind found (re-verified 2026-07-29 by exhaustive file inspection + fresh Figshare API pull) - no participants/labels file, no diagnosis field in any .vhdr/.vmrk header, no decodable patient/control convention across all 98 pseudonymized filenames. DISAGREES with Brief 02's claim of diagnostic categories for 59 DoC patients + 32 controls - see known_limitations.
behavioral_exams: REQUIRES VERIFICATION - not confirmed to be item-level or contemporaneous
size_on_disk: 730.3 MB (VERIFIED via Figshare API; 298 files; BrainVision .dat/.vhdr/.vmrk)
known_limitations: Public description guarantees diagnostic category and EEG but NOT item-level CRS-R, medication timing, etiology or outcome. Epoched rather than continuous raw. RE-VERIFIED 2026-07-29 (exhaustive inspection of every file present, flat directory of 96 .dat/98 .vhdr/98 .vmrk/1 meta.json, plus a fresh independent re-pull of the live Figshare API record byte-identical to the local meta.json cache): NO subject-level diagnostic labels exist anywhere in this download - not in headers, not in markers, not in a separate file, not recoverable from the API. This DIRECTLY DISAGREES with Brief 02's statement that the dataset contains '59 patients with disorders of consciousness' and '32 healthy controls' with an associated behavioral diagnosis: that diagnostic mapping is simply not present in what can be downloaded. Usable only as an unlabeled EEG corpus (e.g., domain-shift or aperiodic-exponent analysis without diagnosis stratification) unless an external label source is located.
leakage_risks: Epochs from one subject must not cross folds
role_in_project: PRIMARY resting-state DoC development set. First real test of UCE v1 vs its one-feature baseline.

name: I-CARE: International Cardiac Arrest REsearch Consortium Database v2.1
n_participants: 607 public patients (per brief - REQUIRES VERIFICATION against RECORDS)
n_recordings: Continuous; up to 5 min per hour to 72 h post-ROSC
eeg_channels: 18 bipolar (per brief); channels vary by hospital and patient (VERIFIED statement)
recording_duration: Hours to several days per patient
labels_available: CPC outcome; demographics; arrest variables; temperature management; signal-quality scores
sedation_data: YES - temperature management recorded; sedation detail REQUIRES VERIFICATION
outcome_data: YES - CPC (PROGNOSTIC ONLY - never a consciousness label)
size_on_disk: 1.5 TB total uncompressed (VERIFIED - NOT the 23.7 GB stated in the brief)
verification_method: Fetched and parsed the PhysioNet landing page
known_limitations: 1.5 TB makes whole-dataset download infeasible here (19 GB free) - selective/streamed access required. CPC is prognosis not consciousness. No command-following testing.
leakage_risks: Hospital identity is a strong acquisition signature - hold out whole hospitals
role_in_project: External validation for acute coma; domain shift; confounder resistance. NEVER a consciousness-label training set.

name: TMS-EEG perturbation in patients with disorders of consciousness v1
access_status: REQUIRES VERIFICATION - EBRAINS access terms not yet checked
labels_available: Perturbational response; frontal and parietal stimulation
known_limitations: Only 12 patients. TMS artefact is severe and preprocessing choices can dominate. Too small to train on.
leakage_risks: Small n invites overfitting if used for anything but convergent validation
role_in_project: Convergent/mechanistic validation only - behaviour-independent cortical reactivity.

name: A repeated awakening study exploring the capacity of complexity measures (propofol sedation and sleep) to reflect subjective experience
license: REQUIRES VERIFICATION (OpenNeuro datasets are usually CC0)
population: Healthy adults; propofol sedation with repeated awakenings
event_markers: YES - awakening timings expected; REQUIRES VERIFICATION
size_on_disk: 83.0 GB (VERIFIED via OpenNeuro GraphQL - EXCEEDS available disk)
known_limitations: 83 GB exceeds the 19 GB free here - requires selective subject-level download. Healthy volunteers only.
leakage_risks: Repeated awakenings within subject - split at subject level
role_in_project: CRITICAL dissociation test: unresponsive WITH reported experience. Directly tests H6.

name: Data supporting Brain connectivity during propofol sedation
reference: Average reference (per brief - data supplied preprocessed)
known_limitations: Supplied PREPROCESSED (filtered, cleaned, average-referenced) - limits preprocessing-sensitivity analysis, which is a Gate A requirement. Propofol only. Healthy volunteers.
leakage_risks: Within-subject conditions - split at subject level
role_in_project: Controlled reversible perturbation; within-subject loss and recovery.

name: VitalDB intraoperative waveform and clinical database
access_status: OPEN - VERIFIED in prior project work
eeg_channels: Varies; frontal EEG/BIS channels in a subset only
labels_available: Anaesthetic agent and concentration; BIS in a subset; hemodynamics; perioperative metadata
behavioral_exams: NO - no structured consciousness examination intraoperatively
known_limitations: No behavioural consciousness testing during surgery. BIS is NOT an awareness label. EEG channels present only in a subset.
leakage_risks: Case identity; do not mix segments of one case across folds
role_in_project: Real-world anaesthesia scale and robustness; drug and age confounding.

name: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database
labels_available: Real vs imagined movement; task class
known_limitations: Healthy motor imagery does NOT demonstrate transfer to DoC patients. Method development only.
leakage_risks: Runs within subject must not cross folds
role_in_project: Motor-imagery decoder development and false-positive calibration ONLY.

name: Multimodal dataset from the CMx7-MM Experiment
labels_available: Motor imagery; passive movement; mental arithmetic; n-back; motor; combined
known_limitations: Healthy only. Modalities include eeg + beh + nirs (VERIFIED).
leakage_risks: 3 sessions per subject - split at subject level
role_in_project: Multi-paradigm intentional-modulation development; avoids over-committing to motor imagery.

name: Sleep-EDF Database Expanded
known_limitations: Sleep stages are NOT levels of consciousness. Only 2 EEG channels - cannot compute frontal/posterior UCE v1 as specified.
role_in_project: Pipeline debugging and state-transition baseline. NOTE: 2-channel montage cannot support UCE v1 regional split.

known_limitations: Requires an approved data-use process. Sleep pathology and age are strong confounders - which is precisely why it is useful as a negative control.
role_in_project: Large-scale sleep validation; tests whether the model mainly tracks age or sleep pathology.

name: MESA Sleep
access_status: REQUIRES VERIFICATION - registration and data-use agreement expected

name: Multitaper spectra recorded during GABAergic anesthetic unconsciousness
access_status: RESTRICTED - PhysioNet credentialed access + signed Data Use Agreement required; VERIFIED
license: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data License 1.5.0 (VERIFIED via view-license page)
population: Healthy volunteers given stepped propofol infusion with responsiveness testing, plus operating-room surgical patients under GABAergic anesthetics (agent(s) REQUIRES VERIFICATION)
n_participants: 54 total: 10 healthy volunteers + 44 OR patients (VERIFIED via PhysioNet content page 2026-07-29); Brief 02 states no participant count for this dataset, so no numeric disagreement to record
n_recordings: REQUIRES VERIFICATION - a WebSearch summary of the associated PLOS ONE paper cites ~33,159 2-second epochs across the cohort, but this was NOT independently confirmed against the PhysioNet page's own file listing
eeg_channels: Volunteer cohort: Fp1 only, extracted from an original 64-channel montage; OR cohort: Fp1, Fp2, F7, F8 (VERIFIED via PhysioNet page)
sampling_rate_hz: Volunteers: 5000; OR patients: 250 (VERIFIED via PhysioNet page; these are the rates underlying the delivered multitaper spectra, not necessarily the delivered file's own rate)
recording_duration: 2-second epochs per case; full case/session duration REQUIRES VERIFICATION
labels_available: Behaviorally-assessed conscious/unconscious label per 2-s epoch for the volunteer cohort (from responsiveness testing during stepped propofol infusion, per PhysioNet page); OR-cohort label basis REQUIRES VERIFICATION (likely time/phase-based, not behavioral)
sedation_data: YES - propofol infusion levels for volunteers (VERIFIED); specific GABAergic agent(s) for OR cohort REQUIRES VERIFICATION
behavioral_exams: YES for volunteer cohort - responsiveness assessed to generate the label (VERIFIED via PhysioNet page); REQUIRES VERIFICATION for OR cohort
size_on_disk: REQUIRES VERIFICATION (not stated on any fetched page)
verification_method: Fetched physionet.org/content/eeg-power-anesthesia/, its /1.0.0/ subpage, and its /view-license/1.0.0/ page directly; cross-checked epoch count only against a WebSearch summary of the linked PLOS ONE paper (paper itself not opened)
known_limitations: Contains ONLY multitaper spectra (100 frequency bins, 0-50 Hz, in dB) - NOT raw EEG. This corroborates Brief 02's own stated limitation ('these are spectra, not necessarily full raw multichannel EEG'). DISAGREEMENT WORTH FLAGGING: Brief 02 lists this plainly under 'PhysioNet' alongside openly-downloadable Tier 2/3/4 resources with no access caveat, but it actually carries PhysioNet's RESTRICTED Health Data License requiring a signed DUA - it is NOT an open download like Sleep-EDF or EEGMMIDB in this same registry. Reduced/aggregated montage (as few as 1 channel for the volunteer cohort) cannot support this project's frontal-vs-posterior UCE regional split.
leakage_risks: Multiple epochs per case/subject - any split MUST be at subject level, not epoch level
role_in_project: Reproduction and spectral sanity-check dataset (Brief 02 Tier 2, item 8 - verbatim stated role).

name: BNCI Horizon 2020 motor-imagery datasets: BCI Competition IV Dataset 2a (001-2014) and Dataset 2b (004-2014)
access_status: OPEN per the BNCI Horizon listing page (no credentialing mentioned there); VERIFIED for that listing page only - the underlying lampx.tugraz.at file-index pages returned HTTP 403 to this tool, so actual file reachability from this environment is REQUIRES VERIFICATION
license: Creative Commons Attribution No Derivatives (CC BY-ND 4.0) (VERIFIED via bnci-horizon-2020.eu/database/data-sets page text, quoted verbatim on the page)
population: Healthy adults performing cue-based motor imagery: 2a = left hand / right hand / both feet / tongue (4-class); 2b = left hand / right hand (2-class), recorded with a bipolar C3/Cz/C4 montage
n_participants: 9 subjects (2a, VERIFIED via bnci-horizon-2020.eu page) + 9 subjects (2b, VERIFIED via bnci-horizon-2020.eu page); whether these are the SAME 9 people or two disjoint cohorts is REQUIRES VERIFICATION
n_recordings: 2a: 2 sessions x 6 runs x 48 trials = 288 trials/session (per a secondary technical description, not the primary page itself - REQUIRES VERIFICATION); 2b: 5 sessions per subject (per WebSearch summary of the download page - REQUIRES VERIFICATION); exact trial counts for 2b REQUIRES VERIFICATION
eeg_channels: 2a: 22 EEG + 3 EOG channels (VERIFIED via bnci-horizon-2020.eu page); 2b: 3 EEG channels (VERIFIED via bnci-horizon-2020.eu page, bipolar C3/Cz/C4 per secondary description) + EOG channel count REQUIRES VERIFICATION
sampling_rate_hz: 250 (per secondary technical descriptions for both 2a and 2b; NOT independently confirmed on the primary lampx.tugraz.at page, which returned HTTP 403 to this tool) - REQUIRES VERIFICATION against the primary source
recording_duration: Cue-based trials of several seconds each; full session duration REQUIRES VERIFICATION
labels_available: Motor-imagery class label only (4-class for 2a, 2-class for 2b) - NOT a consciousness, DoC, or diagnostic label of any kind
event_markers: YES - per-trial cue onset markers (standard BCI-competition GDF/event format, per secondary description) - REQUIRES VERIFICATION against primary file headers
behavioral_exams: N/A - healthy volunteers performing a cued imagery task; no CRS-R-type behavioral exam
site_structure: Single centre (Graz University of Technology, per the hosting institution) - REQUIRES VERIFICATION as the actual recording site
size_on_disk: 2b: approximately 216 MB zipped GDF (per WebSearch summary of the download page - REQUIRES VERIFICATION against the primary listing, which returned HTTP 403); 2a size REQUIRES VERIFICATION
verification_method: Fetched bnci-horizon-2020.eu/database/data-sets directly (license text and per-dataset subject/channel counts read there); the underlying lampx.tugraz.at/~bci/database/001-2014/ file-index page returned HTTP 403 to this tool, so sampling rate, trial counts, EOG-channel count for 2b, and file size are corroborated only via WebSearch summaries of secondary/derivative sources (arXiv papers, library docs), NOT read directly from the primary technical page - flagged REQUIRES VERIFICATION accordingly
known_limitations: Healthy volunteers only - Brief 02 itself states not to use healthy motor imagery as proof of transfer to DoC. CC BY-ND explicitly PROHIBITS derivative works and modified redistribution, which LICENSE_TABLE.csv must reflect (this is more restrictive than the CC BY / CC0 licenses elsewhere in this registry). Primary technical listing page blocked this tool (HTTP 403); the specific numeric fields above need a direct re-check before being relied on for method development budgeting.
leakage_risks: Multiple sessions per subject (2 for 2a, 5 for 2b) - any split MUST be at subject level, not session or trial level
role_in_project: Session-to-session transfer, subject adaptation, calibration burden, motor-imagery paradigm robustness, and decoder benchmarking (paraphrased from Brief 02 Tier 4, item 13 - the brief has no explicit 'Role' heading for this entry, unlike its other items).
